note: The listing template for a seller's branded shopper app. The same template serves every business: {{brand_name}} is the business's own name (at most 30 characters, the brand file's limit), {{shop_name_short}} its short name. Buyers see the seller's brand only, so no text here names the platform; tools/review-pack fails if one does, and if any text is over a store's limit with a 30-character name. The permission sentences are the shopper app's own usage descriptions (apps/shopper/app.config.js).

play.title: {{brand_name}}
play.shortDescription: Shop {{brand_name}} and track your orders in the app.
play.fullDescription:
{{brand_name}} in your pocket. Browse the catalog, save favourites, pay securely and follow every order until it arrives.

Shop
- Browse products and collections, with photos and videos.
- Save items to your wishlist and come back to them.
- Pay with UPI, cards, netbanking or cash on delivery where the shop offers it.

Orders
- Track every order, from packed to delivered.
- Start a return or exchange, with a photo of the item.
- Leave a review with a photo.

Your account
- Sign in with a WhatsApp code, Google or Apple. There are no passwords.
- Keep your addresses, so checkout takes a few taps.
- Choose which notifications you get, and when.

Permissions
- The camera and photo library are used only when you add a photo for a return or a review.
- Notifications tell you about your orders; offers only if you choose them.

You can delete your account in the app at any time.

reviewNotes: The app opens on the shop {{brand_name}}. Use the review sign-in: in the app's sign-in screen enter the review phone number and code given in the credentials fields. The demo account has sample orders and a saved address. No payment is taken: the review build uses the payment gateway's test mode, and cash on delivery needs no payment. Notifications can be allowed or refused; the app works either way. Delete the account from the account screen.
